title: I built an AI-powered Trading website to analyze financial charts
author: Important_Morning423
selftext:
I made an AI trading website which provides signal recommendation (buy/sell) with market research analysis. It is pretty simple to use just need few things to proceed and your AI analysis is ready in seconds. Due to api costing i never deployed it, so i need to make some stratergies to find a customers for my application.

**HOW TO USE:**

Use this Telegram bot to get demo of the application:

1. Open telegram application

2. Search for "@trendmaster\_ai\_bot" or dm me in comment

# What you get ?

* Image prediction / AI annotated Chart
* Signal Recommendation buy/sell
* Confidence Score
* Pattern analysis
* Entry Zone/ Entry Point
* Target Value
* Stop Loss 
* Detailed AI analysis with summary

  
The goal is to keep the workflow as frictionless as possible. Traders just send their chart link or a screenshot to the bot, and it processes the data to provide an analysis. I’ve focused heavily on keeping the UX simple—no complex logins, just a direct bot interaction.
